nat.sense: Set national heat thresholds and link weather alerts to health and death data.
nat.decide: Recognise extreme heat as a disaster, with a budget set aside before each season.
nat.act: Enforce heat-safe work rules, cooling standards and free care for heat illness.
nat.sustain: Cut emissions, build social protection and keep heat in every national plan.

city.sense: Map the hottest streets, homes and people, and who is most at risk.
city.decide: Adopt and fund a city heat action plan with clear owners.
city.act: Open cooling centres, shade streets, cool roofs and check on people living alone.
city.sustain: Build heat into planning, building codes and housing upgrades.

health.sense: Track heat illness and excess deaths in real time during heatwaves.
health.decide: Trigger surge plans and outreach when forecasts cross danger levels.
health.act: Prepare clinics with cooling, backup power and trained staff.
health.sustain: Record heat on death certificates and train every frontline worker.

met.sense: Forecast dangerous heat, including hot nights and humid heat.
met.decide: Agree danger thresholds with health, labour and disaster agencies.
met.act: Issue early, local warnings that trigger action, not just information.
met.sustain: Keep improving forecasts and share data openly.

employers.sense: Measure heat at the workplace, not just the city forecast.
employers.decide: Set heat rules for rest, water, shade and hours before summer begins.
employers.act: Give paid breaks and move heavy work to cooler hours.
employers.sustain: Build heat into contracts, supply chains and workplace design.

workers.sense: Collect members’ experiences of heat at work and at home.
workers.decide: Put heat protection on the bargaining table.
workers.act: Win paid rest, water, shade and income protection.
workers.sustain: Make heat rights part of every agreement and law.

utilities.sense: Forecast peak cooling demand and the points where the grid will fail.
utilities.decide: Protect supply to clinics, water pumps and cooling centres first.
utilities.act: Offer lifeline tariffs and demand response, and support efficient cooling.
utilities.sustain: Shift to clean power that doesn’t depend on scarce water.

water.sense: Monitor reservoirs, aquifers and pumping during hot spells.
water.decide: Agree fair sharing of scarce water between homes, farms and power.
water.act: Keep water flowing with backup power and emergency supply.
water.sustain: Recharge aquifers and set fair pumping rules.

agri.sense: Watch soil moisture and crop heat stress through the season.
agri.decide: Advise farmers when to plant, irrigate and protect animals.
agri.act: Spread mulching, agroforestry, efficient irrigation and heat-tolerant varieties.
agri.sustain: Restore soils and watersheds so land stays cooler.

schools.sense: Monitor classroom temperatures and attendance in hot months.
schools.decide: Adjust timetables and calendars before heat closes schools.
schools.act: Cool classrooms and keep school meals going.
schools.sustain: Build cooler schools and support that keeps children enrolled.

insurers.sense: Price heat risk with local data, and watch arrears in heat-exposed districts after each hot season.
insurers.decide: Design cover that pays out quickly when heat crosses a threshold, and add heatwaves to the calamities that switch on loan relief.
insurers.act: Offer parametric heat insurance to workers and small businesses, and repayment relief when heat strikes.
insurers.sustain: Share risk through public–private pools so cover stays available.

funders.sense: Fund heat data and the tracking of deaths.
funders.act: Finance cooling centres, clinics, cool housing and income protection.
funders.sustain: Back the institutions that deliver protection year after year.

community.sense: Know who lives alone, who works outside and who has no cooling.
community.decide: Agree a neighbourhood plan for heatwaves.
community.act: Check on neighbours, run cooling spaces and share warnings.
community.sustain: Hold institutions to account and keep local knowledge alive.

intl.sense: Track global warming and heat impacts across countries.
intl.decide: Agree standards on emissions, refrigerants and work in heat.
intl.act: Support countries to adopt and enforce those standards.
intl.sustain: Keep finance and technology flowing to the places most at risk.
